definitions: A line or ridge produced on paper or cloth by folding, pressing, or crushing it.
A wrinkle or line in the skin, especially on the face.
In cricket, any of several lines marked on the pitch to define the positions of the batsmen or bowler.
In ice hockey, the area in front of the goal.
examples: A sharp crease in his trousers.
The batsman stepped out of his crease.
The puck entered the goal crease.
